messages:
Sam Huang: quick eye on the new mock — placing a tiny persistent 'Interrupt' pill next to the composer send button and a separate 'Regenerate' caret menu. trying to keep the chat rail clean. initial thoughts?
Maya Patel: I like proximity to composer for discoverability. question: should regen be a simple tap (abort+regen) or open options (restart/append)?
Jon Rivera: engineering: abort+regen immediate is simplest and feels snappy. we can add a long-press/menu for advanced options later. debounce 350ms to avoid duplicate calls.
Priya Singh: accessibility: icon-only controls must have aria-labels. make the pill announce final states only (aria-live polite): 'Generation complete' or 'Generation interrupted'. don't announce token increments while streaming.
Sam Huang: copy tweak: prefer the verb 'Interrupt' over 'Stop' to reduce perceived data loss. regen tooltip: 'Regenerate response (Ctrl/⌘ + .)'.
Maya Patel: token counter behavior: show an approximate live token readout like '~120 tok' updating at most every 500ms; reveal exact token count only after generation finishes. add reduced-motion support to disable pulsing.
Jon Rivera: backend note: UI can sample locally for updates; send aggregated telemetry every 10s. add a per-org flag to opt out of live token UI.
Priya Singh: focus management: when user triggers Interrupt, return focus to composer and announce 'Generation interrupted, focus returned to composer'. when generation completes, focus remains in composer and announce 'Response complete'.
Sam Huang: prompt library tie-in: show a compact 'Est. 45 tok' badge under prompt titles. on prompts with variables, show the estimate before run and a toggle 'Show exact estimate' for advanced users.
Maya Patel: microcopy options for regen menu (for future): 'Restart generation' vs 'Append new output'. we'll A/B test wording. for now immediate abort+regen default.
Jon Rivera: also adding a small queued state: if regen is pressed mid-stream, flash the regen icon and set state 'queued' while abort occurs, then start new generation.
Priya Singh: keyboard access: keep Esc as a fallback interrupt (watch for editor collisions) and surface Ctrl/⌘ + . as primary regen shortcut in tooltips and help. ensure shortcuts documented in prompt library docs.
ConsoleBot: mock updated by Sam Huang at 3381234700 (Figma link posted in channel).
Sam Huang: thanks team  I'll update the fig and drop a 10s prototype video. ping me for a quick a11y pass once proto is up.
